basic_details.job_title: IIA Research Trainee Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: One Research Trainee (Observations) post at Vainu Bappu Observatory (VBO), Kavalur, carries a consolidated remuneration of Rs. 30,000 per month for a one-year contract traineeship that may be extended annually up to five years. The Indian Institute of Astrophysics (IIA), an autonomous body under the Department of Science & Technology, Government of India, invites online applications at https://www.iiap.res.in/iia_jobs/. The last date for receipt of online applications is 9 December 2026 at 17:30 hours.

age_limit.details: Age relaxation is permissible to SC, ST and OBC candidates and also to Persons with Disabilities (PwD) candidates, as notified by the Government of India from time to time. The notice does not print the number of years.

qualification.details: M.Sc in Physics / Astrophysics with a minimum of 60% aggregate marks from a recognized University/Institution. The notice does not print a passing-year window. | Candidates with work experience in astronomical observations, telescopes or data analyses will be given preference. Proof of the work experience should be enclosed while applying. The prescribed qualifications are the minimum required, and mere possession of them does not entitle a candidate to be called for interview.

salary_details.remuneration: Rs. 30,000/- per month (Consolidated), inclusive of all allowances
salary_details.annual increase: Rs. 2,500/- in the remuneration, based on satisfactory performance
salary_details.tenure: One year, extendable annually for four years (total five years of traineeship), subject to satisfactory performance of the candidate and requirement of the Project assessed annually
salary_details.details: The appointment does not entitle the candidate to any privileges or benefits of regular employment, and no claim for regular employment in the Institute will be entertained.

selection_process: The notice mentions a written test and an interview. It is open to the Institute to conduct a written test to shortlist candidates for interview in case the attendance of candidates is more.

how_to_apply: Submit the application through the online mode only. The notice directs candidates to https://www.iiap.res.in/iia_jobs/ for registration.
Upload a scanned Curriculum Vitae (CV) in the online application.
Upload a Date of Birth Proof and the Educational Qualification documents.
Upload the Experience documents (proof of work experience) and the Community Certificates.
Make sure the completed online application is received by 9 December 2026 at 17:30 hours.
important_instructions: The selected candidate will be posted to work in VBO, Kavalur, and is liable to be posted anywhere in India as per the requirement of the Institute. The Institute reserves the right to cancel the entire recruitment process at any time without assigning any reasons. No correspondence will be entertained with candidates not selected for interview or appointment. Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification. Misrepresentation or falsification of facts, or misconduct or misbehaviour at any stage of the selection process, will result in cancellation of candidature without any notice.

content_sections.heading: About the Institute
content_sections.text: The Indian Institute of Astrophysics is an autonomous academic national institution under the Department of Science & Technology, Government of India, dedicated to research in Astronomy, Astrophysics and Allied Sciences & Technology. Its main campus is in Koramangala, Bengaluru, and it also has the CREST Campus at Hosakote, Bengaluru. It operates field stations at Kavalur and Kodaikanal in Tamil Nadu, Gauribidanur in Karnataka, and Leh/Hanle in the Union Territory of Ladakh.

content_sections.heading: Seats by Trade
content_sections.text: The notice does not print a category-wise break-up. It also states that the Institute reserves the right to increase or decrease the number of posts advertised.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: M.Sc in Physics / Astrophysics with a minimum of 60% aggregate marks from a recognized University/Institution. The notice does not print a passing-year window. Candidates with work experience in astronomical observations, telescopes or data analyses will be given preference. Proof of the work experience should be enclosed while applying. The prescribed qualifications are the minimum required, and mere possession of them does not entitle a candidate to be called for interview. The age limit is 26 years. The date for determining the upper age limit, qualifications and experience is the closing date prescribed for receipt of completed applications, which is 9 December 2026. Age relaxation is permissible to SC, ST and OBC candidates and also to Persons with Disabilities (PwD) candidates, as notified by the Government of India from time to time. The notice does not print the number of years. Only candidates of Indian Nationality can apply for this position. The candidate should be fit enough and willing to work full night (up to 12 hours). Candidates should check the official notification for any further eligibility details.

content_sections.heading: Stipend and Training Period
content_sections.text: The appointment does not entitle the candidate to any privileges or benefits of regular employment, and no claim for regular employment in the Institute will be entertained.

The candidates should be fit enough and willing to work full night (up to 12 hours).

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIA Research Trainee (Observations)
content_sections.text: Submit the application through the online mode only. The notice directs candidates to https://www.iiap.res.in/iia_jobs/ for registration. Upload a scanned Curriculum Vitae (CV) in the online application. Upload a Date of Birth Proof and the Educational Qualification documents. Upload the Experience documents (proof of work experience) and the Community Certificates. Make sure the completed online application is received by 9 December 2026 at 17:30 hours. content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notice mentions a written test and an interview. It is open to the Institute to conduct a written test to shortlist candidates for interview in case the attendance of candidates is more. Where the number of applications is large and it is not convenient or possible to interview all of them, the Institute reserves the right to limit the number of candidates called for interview on the basis of qualifications and experience higher than the minimum prescribed, and also by conducting a written test. The notice does not give the test pattern, marks or the interview date.

faq.question: Q1. How many Research Trainee (Observations) posts has IIA announced?
faq.answer: IIA has announced one (01) post of Research Trainee (Observations), to work at Vainu Bappu Observatory (VBO), Kavalur.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the IIA Research Trainee post?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of online applications is 9 December 2026 at 17:30 hours.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for IIA Research Trainee (Observations)?
faq.answer: The qualification is M.Sc in Physics / Astrophysics with a minimum of 60% aggregate marks from a recognized University/Institution. Experience in astronomical observations, telescopes or data analyses is preferred.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the IIA Research Trainee post?
faq.answer: The age limit is 26 years, determined as on the closing date for receipt of applications. Age relaxation is permissible for SC, ST, OBC and PwD candidates as notified by the Government of India from time to time.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of IIA Research Trainee (Observations)?
faq.answer: The remuneration is Rs. 30,000/- per month (consolidated), inclusive of all allowances, with an annual increase of Rs. 2,500/- based on satisfactory performance.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for IIA Research Trainee (Observations)?
faq.answer: Apply through the online mode only, registering at https://www.iiap.res.in/iia_jobs/ and uploading the scanned CV, date of birth proof, educational qualification, experience and community certificates.

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected for the IIA Research Trainee post?
faq.answer: Candidates are called for interview, and the Institute may conduct a written test to shortlist candidates for interview if attendance is more.

faq.question: Q8. Is the IIA Research Trainee post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is purely temporary on contract basis, with a one-year tenure extendable annually for four years (total five years), and it gives no claim to regular employment.

faq.question: Q9. Can non-Indian nationals apply for this IIA post?
faq.answer: No. Only candidates of Indian Nationality can apply for the Research Trainee (Observations) position.

faq.question: Q10. Where will the Research Trainee be posted?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will be posted at Vainu Bappu Observatory (VBO), Kavalur, and is liable to be posted anywhere in India as per the requirement of the Institute.
